title.zh: 10月4日11:07 CST复核：中尼伤亡基线未变
title.en: 4 Oct 11:07 CST recheck: CN and NP baselines unchanged
title.ne: 4 Oct 11:07 CST: CN/NP baseline na badlieko
title.hi: 4 Oct 11:07 CST: CN/NP baseline nahin badla

body.zh: 新华社、gov.cn、日喀则简报及@XHNews/@CCTV_Plus自10月1日无新吉隆伤亡帖。中方仍为9月5日18时：43死、519失联、2人获救。尼泊尔警察9月28日11时：1454死、4718失踪。NDRRMA获救仍为9月26日13795。交通厅网9月28日G216仍双向管制。无新UNOSAT/Copernicus EMS。
body.en: No new Gyirong casualty post from Xinhua, gov.cn, Shigatse, @XHNews or @CCTV_Plus since 1 Oct. CN remains 5 Sep 18:00: 43 dead, 519 missing, 2 rescued. Nepal Police 28 Sep 11:00: 1454 dead, 4718 missing. NDRRMA rescued remains 26 Sep 13795. Transport bulletin 28 Sep: G216 still two-way control. No new UNOSAT/Copernicus EMS.
body.ne: Xinhua/gov.cn/Shigatse/@XHNews/@CCTV_Plus ma 1 Oct pachi naya Gyirong casualty chaina. CN 5 Sep 18:00: 43/519/2. Nepal Police 28 Sep 11:00: 1454/4718. NDRRMA uddar 26 Sep 13795. G216 28 Sep dui tira niyantran. Naya UNOSAT/Copernicus EMS chaina.
body.hi: Xinhua/gov.cn/Shigatse/@XHNews/@CCTV_Plus se 1 Oct ke baad naya Gyirong casualty nahi. CN 5 Sep 18:00: 43/519/2. Nepal Police 28 Sep 11:00: 1454/4718. NDRRMA uddhar 26 Sep 13795. G216 28 Sep dono disha niyantran. Naya UNOSAT/Copernicus EMS nahi.

title.zh: 尼泊尔警察9月28日11时：1454死、4718失踪

body.zh: Nepal News引尼泊尔警察：截至9月28日11时博特科西洪水死亡1454（拉苏瓦236），失踪4718，安置点1283人，警力部署7975人。获救数未在此稿更新。
body.en: Nepal News cites Nepal Police: as of 28 Sep 11:00, Bhotekoshi flood deaths 1454 (Rasuwa 236), missing 4718, 1283 in holding centres, 7975 police deployed. Rescued not updated in this report.
body.ne: Nepal News/Nepal Police 28 Sep 11:00: 1454 mrit (Rasuwa 236), 4718 harayeka, kendra ma 1283, police 7975. Uddar yo report ma chaina.
body.hi: Nepal News/Nepal Police 28 Sep 11:00: 1454 mrit (Rasuwa 236), 4718 lapata, kendron mein 1283, police 7975. Uddhar is report mein nahi.

title.zh: 交通厅9月28日：G216吉隆镇—国门仍双向管制
title.en: Transport dept 28 Sep: G216 Gyirong town–gate still both ways controlled
title.ne: Transport 28 Sep: G216 Gyirong town–gate dui tira niyantran
title.hi: Transport 28 Sep: G216 Gyirong town–gate dono disha niyantran

body.zh: 西藏自治区交通运输厅路网：G216 K3500+200（吉隆镇）—K3525+850（吉隆国门）自8月26日起双向交通管制，解除时间待定。抢险通道不等于社会通车或口岸通关。
body.en: Xizang transport network: G216 K3500+200 (Gyirong town) to K3525+850 (gate) remains under two-way control since 26 Aug; lift time unset. Rescue track is not public traffic or port clearance.
body.ne: Xizang transport: G216 K3500+200–K3525+850 26 Aug dekhi dui tira niyantran. Rescue bato sarwajanik hoina.
body.hi: Xizang transport: G216 K3500+200–K3525+850 26 Aug se dono disha niyantran. Rescue path janta ke liye nahi.

body.zh: PTI引NDRRMA 9月26日：1453死、5285失踪、13795获救；21个安置点约1113人（拉苏瓦805）。失踪与警方后续口径不同，KPI失踪采用较新警方数。
body.en: PTI cites NDRRMA 26 Sep: 1453 dead, 5285 missing, 13795 rescued; about 1113 in 21 holding centres (805 in Rasuwa). Missing differs from later police count; KPI missing uses the later police figure.
body.ne: PTI/NDRRMA 26 Sep: 1453/5285/13795; 21 kendra ma 1113 (Rasuwa 805). Harayeka police pachi farak. KPI harayeka police ank.
body.hi: PTI/NDRRMA 26 Sep: 1453/5285/13795; 21 kendron mein 1113 (Rasuwa 805). Lapata police se alag. KPI lapata police ank.

title.zh: 指挥部9月6日：截至9月5日18时43死519失联
title.en: Command 6 Sep: as of 5 Sep 18:00, 43 dead, 519 missing
title.ne: Command 6 Sep: 5 Sep 18:00 samma 43 mrit, 519 samparka bihin
title.hi: Command 6 Sep: 5 Sep 18:00 tak 43 mrit, 519 lapata

body.zh: 央广网引吉隆应急救援指挥部：43人遇难、519人失联、成功救出2人、遗物993件。外籍失联261人、23国。此后新华社与@XHNews未见更新伤亡。
body.en: CNR cites the Gyirong command: 43 dead, 519 missing, 2 rescued, 993 personal effects. 261 missing foreigners from 23 countries. No later casualty update from Xinhua or @XHNews.
body.ne: CNR: 43 mrit, 519 samparka bihin, 2 uddar, 993 saman. Bideshi 261. Xinhua/@XHNews pachi naya casualty chaina.
body.hi: CNR: 43 mrit, 519 lapata, 2 uddhar, 993 saman. Videshi 261. Xinhua/@XHNews ke baad naya casualty nahi.

title.zh: 新华社9月5日：口岸上方堰塞湖已排空
title.en: Xinhua 5 Sep: barrier lake above the port drained
title.ne: Xinhua 5 Sep: port mathi ko bandha tal khali
title.hi: Xinhua 5 Sep: port ke upar ka barrier lake khali

body.zh: 西藏应急管理部门：堰塞湖已排空，河道恢复正常过流，危险基本解除。此后无新堰塞湖通报。
body.en: Xizang emergency management: the lake has drained, the channel is flowing normally, and the hazard is largely eliminated. No later barrier-lake bulletin.
body.ne: Xizang emergency: tal khali, nadi sadharan, jokhim dherai kam. Pachi naya tal bulletin chaina.
body.hi: Xizang emergency: jheel khali, nadi normal, khatra lagbhag khatam. Baad mein naya jheel bulletin nahi.

title.en: ReliefWeb cites NDRRMA 21 Sep: 1411 dead, 5875 missing

body.zh: IFRC DREF更新引用9月21日NDRRMA：1411死、5875失踪、13784获救。已被后续基线取代。未见新的UNOSAT/Copernicus EMS产品。
body.en: IFRC DREF update cites NDRRMA 21 Sep: 1411 dead, 5875 missing, 13784 rescued. Superseded by later baselines. No new UNOSAT or Copernicus EMS product found.
body.ne: IFRC DREF: 21 Sep NDRRMA 1411/5875/13784. Pachi baseline le badliyo. Naya UNOSAT/Copernicus EMS chaina.
body.hi: IFRC DREF: 21 Sep NDRRMA 1411/5875/13784. Baad baseline ne badla. Naya UNOSAT/Copernicus EMS nahi.

title.zh: 美国驻尼使馆9月3日：勿前往Rasuwagadhi–Timure
title.en: US Embassy Nepal 3 Sep: do not travel Rasuwagadhi–Timure
title.hi: US Embassy 3 Sep: Rasuwagadhi–Timure mat jao

body.zh: 使馆道路告示仍为9月3日：勿前往Rasuwagadhi–Timure–Syafrubesi。未见更新告示。
body.en: Embassy road notice remains 3 Sep: do not travel to Rasuwagadhi–Timure–Syafrubesi. No newer notice found.
body.ne: Embassy notice 3 Sep nai: Rasuwagadhi–Timure–Syafrubesi najau. Naya notice chaina.
body.hi: Embassy notice 3 Sep hi: Rasuwagadhi–Timure–Syafrubesi mat jao. Naya notice nahi.

detail.zh: 口岸设施已毁，通关未恢复。中方关闭。
detail.en: Port facilities destroyed; clearance not restored. Chinese side closed.
detail.ne: Port dhvasta; clearance khuleko chaina. Chiniya taraf band.
detail.hi: Port dhvast; clearance nahi. Chini taraf band.

detail.zh: 交通厅9月28日路网：K3500+200—K3525+850双向管制，解除时间待定。抢险通道仅救援。
detail.en: Transport bulletin 28 Sep: K3500+200–K3525+850 two-way control, lift time unset. Rescue track only.
detail.ne: 28 Sep road info: K3500+200–K3525+850 dui tira niyantran. Rescue bato matra.
detail.hi: 28 Sep road info: K3500+200–K3525+850 dono disha niyantran. Rescue path hi.

detail.zh: 截至9月5日18时：2500余人、核心区搜寻与消杀已覆盖。无新现场坐标。
detail.en: As of 5 Sep 18:00: 2500+ personnel; core search and disinfection covered. No new live GNSS.
detail.ne: 5 Sep 18:00: 2500+ jana; core khoj cover. Naya GNSS chaina.
detail.hi: 5 Sep 18:00: 2500+ log; core khoj cover. Naya GNSS nahi.

detail.zh: 警方9月28日：部署7975人做搜救与遗体管理。无新队伍坐标，故不标经纬度。
detail.en: Police 28 Sep: 7975 deployed for search and body management. No new team GNSS, so no lat/lng.
detail.ne: Police 28 Sep: 7975 jana. Toli GNSS chaina, lat/lng chaina.
detail.hi: Police 28 Sep: 7975 log. Team GNSS nahi, lat/lng nahi.

detail.zh: 9月5日指挥部：核心区搜寻与预防性消杀已全覆盖。
detail.en: 5 Sep command: core-area search and preventive disinfection fully covered.
detail.ne: 5 Sep command: core khoj ra disinfection cover.
detail.hi: 5 Sep command: core khoj aur disinfection cover.

detail.zh: 8月30日发布会：转移安置吉隆镇、萨勒乡5村499人。未见更新。
detail.en: 30 Aug briefing: 499 people from Gyirong town and Sale township relocated. No update.
detail.ne: 30 Aug: Gyirong town/Sale 5 gaun 499 sthanantran. Update chaina.
detail.hi: 30 Aug: Gyirong town/Sale 5 gaon 499 sthanantran. Update nahi.

status.zh: 堰塞湖已排空，河道正常过流（新华社9月5日）
status.en: Barrier lake drained; channel flowing normally (Xinhua 5 Sep)
status.ne: Bandha tal khali; nadi sadharan (Xinhua 5 Sep)
status.hi: Barrier lake khali; nadi normal (Xinhua 5 Sep)

text.zh: 新华社：出入境警察肖福贵灾后拍摄吉隆口岸无人机画面。无新伤亡数字。
text.en: Xinhua: immigration officer Xiao Fugui drone footage near Gyirong Port after the mudslide. No new casualty figure.
text.ne: Xinhua: Gyirong Port drone. Naya casualty chaina.
text.hi: Xinhua: Gyirong Port drone. Naya casualty nahi.

text.zh: 国家气候中心向尼泊尔提供滚动气候监测与预报，支持吉隆—拉苏瓦口岸泥石流救援。无新伤亡。
text.en: National Climate Center providing Nepal rolling climate monitoring for Gyirong–Rasuwa mudslide relief. No new casualties.
text.ne: Climate Center le Nepal lai Gyirong–Rasuwa anuman. Naya casualty chaina.
text.hi: Climate Center Nepal ko Gyirong–Rasuwa forecast. Naya casualty nahi.

text.zh: 国家气候中心向尼泊尔提供滚动气候监测，支持吉隆—拉苏瓦口岸泥石流救援。
text.en: National Climate Center giving Nepal rolling climate products for Gyirong–Rasuwa mudslide relief.
text.ne: Climate Center le Nepal lai Gyirong–Rasuwa uddar ko lagi climate anuman.
text.hi: Climate Center Nepal ko Gyirong–Rasuwa uddhar ke liye climate forecast.

text.zh: 灾后留在吉隆镇的尼泊尔工人继续工作，希望灾区尽快恢复。无新伤亡。
text.en: Nepali workers remaining in Gyirong Town continue work and hope for recovery. No new casualties.
text.ne: Gyirong Town ma Nepali karmi le kaam gare. Naya casualty chaina.
text.hi: Gyirong Town mein Nepali karmchari kaam jaari. Naya casualty nahi.

text.zh: 志愿者在吉隆县向受灾群众与滞留尼泊尔公民发放免费餐食。无新伤亡。
text.en: Volunteers handing out free meals to affected residents and stranded Nepalis in Gyirong County. No new casualties.
text.ne: Gyirong ma swayamsevak le bhojan baade. Naya casualty chaina.
text.hi: Gyirong mein swayamsevak bhojan de rahe. Naya casualty nahi.

text.zh: 新华社汇总吉隆口岸泥石流与中方救援进展。未给出超过9月5日的新伤亡。
text.en: Xinhua roundup of the Gyirong Port mudslide and Chinese rescue. No casualty figure later than 5 Sep.
text.ne: Xinhua Gyirong Port saransh. 5 Sep pachi naya casualty chaina.
text.hi: Xinhua Gyirong Port roundup. 5 Sep ke baad naya casualty nahi.
